Here’s a polished response you could send back to Melissa that shows ownership while also clarifying your perspective:  

---

Hi Melissa,  

I completely understand and appreciate the reminder. I want you to know I am trying to take full ownership here and not let this become a recurring issue. I do stay on the team about their content, but I try not to bug everyone constantly. I also asked the group to help me out more with staying on schedule, but I think we all just got a little overwhelmed with everything going on this past month.  

That said, I agree with you that an extra push from management might have helped keep things on track this time. Going forward, if I don’t have what I need, I’ll make sure to let you or Heather know right away so the Alert doesn’t get held up.  

Thanks for calling it out—I’ll make sure this process stays consistent moving forward.  

Best,  
Bethany  

---
